name: JINUSHI Co.,Ltd.
summary: JINUSHI Co.,Ltd. engages in the real estate investment business in Japan. The company operates in three segments: Real Estate Investment Business; Real Estate Leasing; and Asset Management Business. The company purchases and sells land, as well as sells real estate financial products. It also engages in long-term leasing; subleasing of land; and asset and operation management. The company was formerly known as Nippon Commercial Development Co., Ltd. JINUSHI Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
